name: Tide Pool Holding a Shattered Moon Reflection
description: A close-up tide pool at night holds a fractured moon reflection, with seaweed, shells, and moonlight on wet rock.
prompt: A single close-up night image of a tide pool holding a shattered moon reflection. Wet black rock, seaweed, small shells, moonlight, gentle ripples, deep blue and silver tones, peaceful surreal mood, no text, no logos, no watermark.
caption: The moon can break into a hundred quiet pieces.
